title: Biblical Lexemes Dictionary
description: Mapping of lexeme IDs to lexicon entries including lemma, gloss, POS enum, total count, Beta Code, and Strong's number.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for the lexeme.

lemma.description: Authoritative lexical headword form in original language script.

total.description: Corpus-wide occurrence count of this lexeme.

beta.description: Simplified ASCII Beta Code or transliteration for searching.

plain.description: Lowercase unaccented plain text for fuzzy and case-insensitive search.

strongs.description: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance identifier number (if assigned).
